target: Chinese X relevant readers across the project themes; select a comparable topic block for each pilot, do not permanently narrow account to AI.
missingness_rule: Unknown stays null; never infer missed historical observations from current totals.

prospective_comparisons.comparison: direct statement of same kind of independently sourced fact
prospective_comparisons.support: Source code verifies facts only; Upworthy supplies comparison method, not X content effectiveness.

prospective_comparisons.comparison: description of capability without demonstrated result
prospective_comparisons.counterexample_requirement: Seek nonviral demos and successful plain descriptions before claiming mechanism.
Keep successful feature-only posts and failed boundary posts.

assessment: Within-topic repeated observations and independent-author/later-date holdouts; a sequential X publishing comparison is not a randomized A/B test. No formula promotion from score or single winner.
